verdict.rationale: Gide has its own Data Protection page covering GDPR compliance and regulator-facing work, namely CNIL sanctions proceedings. It also has a dedicated 'IT, Digital & Cybersecurity' practice page. However, none of the quoted content explicitly describes security-incident or breach response work. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of incident/breach response services (breach notification to the CNIL or data subjects, forensic coordination, crisis handling), regulator-facing breach work beyond sanctions proceedings, and independent corroboration or matter examples.
